department: Arenberg Doctoral School / Department of Electrical Engineering (ESAT)

deadline.value: KU Leuven doctoral admissions have no general deadline; individual supervisors or research projects have their own deadlines.
deadline.quote: This guide explains the different steps to apply for a doctoral programme at KU Leuven. There is no general application deadline. It is possible, however, that an individual supervisor or project does have deadlines.

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold a relevant master's degree with distinction, or an equivalent higher education degree from abroad, or pass a predoctoral exam.
entry_route.quote:
Every PhD candidate must meet the following requirements:
Either you hold a Flemish Master’s degree relevant to the doctoral research or an equivalent higher education degree from abroad, obtained with at least the degree of distinction or have distinguished yourself with high-quality scientific publications or design-oriented achievements,
Or you have passed the predoctoral exam with the degree of distinction.

supervisor.value: Applicants cannot initiate the admission procedure directly; a KU Leuven supervisor must start the application on the candidate's behalf.
supervisor.quote: You cannot initiate the application procedure yourself. Regardless of your starting point, your KU Leuven supervisor will start up the application procedure on your behalf.

funding.value: PhD positions advertised on the KU Leuven jobsite have financing already arranged by the supervisor.
funding.quote: The PhD positions on the KU Leuven jobsite already have financing available (via the supervisor).

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Doctoral Programme in Engineering Science: Electrical Engineering at KU Leuven.
